category: contrasting nearby identities and opposing image motion
reference: Opposite horizontal image directions: opening white SUV 2 shifts right; rack-equipped white pickup 6 shifts left.
grounding: Compare exact endpoints 1 and 100 for both identities. SUV 2 centre x increases from about 504.7 to 954.0; pickup 6 centre x decreases from about 1054.5 to 474.8. Original and privacy-processed views distinguish the enclosed SUV from the rack-equipped pickup. This is net endpoint image motion, not a claim of monotonically moving in one direction throughout.
prohibited_claims: claiming both move left or both move right
substituting physical lane changes or world-direction motion for image displacement

category: visible pickup subtype versus broad annotation and closed-truck foil
reference: An open-bed pickup with a tall metal rack, track 6; it is not the closed box truck.
grounding: Original and privacy-processed crop of vehicle 6 at frame 100 show the pickup cab, bed/rack profile and open lattice framework. Its EMT category is Medium_vehicle, which is broader than the visible pickup subtype. Closed box truck 14 ahead is a separate object.
prohibited_claims: calling pickup 6 the closed box truck
treating Medium_vehicle as evidence that visible pickup body shape cannot be identified

reference: No, the earlier rack-equipped white pickup is not visible in frame 150.
grounding: Establish pickup 6 from its earlier original/privacy-processed views, for example frame 100, and inspect the complete scene at frame 150. Its last annotation is 141, but labels alone do not establish absence. White SUV 2, white car 4 and closed truck 14 remain separate identities and are not the rack-equipped pickup.
prohibited_claims: substituting a remaining white SUV or closed box truck for pickup 6
using the last annotation alone to prove absence
inferring the pickup stopped existing or left the road

category: truly hidden occupancy versus visible object presence
reference: The number of people inside the black SUV cannot be determined from the available rear exterior view.
grounding: SUV 16 is clearly visible in scene 150 and in its privacy-processed crop. Dark windows, distance and rear viewing angle do not establish an interior occupant count. Processing masks the lower 40 percent of annotated non-person vehicle boxes; it does not justify claiming the whole cabin or all windows were masked.
prohibited_claims: invented occupant count, including zero or an assumed driver count
claiming the SUV is absent because its occupants are unobservable
claiming the entire cabin was covered by the lower-vehicle privacy mask

category: English-only city OCR and narrow answer scope
grounding: In scene 150, the large blue sign to the left of the Al Fay Rd exit sign shows Sh Mohammed Bin Zayed Rd, with Abu Dhabi below it. Both original and 1024-pixel-wide privacy-processed scene were inspected; no vehicle track is needed. The requested answer is the city, not the road name.
prohibited_claims: answering Al Fay Rd or Sh Mohammed Bin Zayed Rd instead of the city
adding Arabic text or unsupported transliteration

category: bounded temporal size control on a different vehicle
reference: Larger in the image at frame 150 than at frame 50.
grounding: Compare black SUV 16 at exact endpoints 50 and 150. Annotated width/height increase from about 105.4 by 82.5 pixels to 254.7 by 180.1 pixels; original and privacy-processed upper-body crops support the growth. Other white vehicles and the pickup are different identities.
prohibited_claims: using pickup 6 or white SUV 2 instead of black SUV 16
asserting calibrated physical speed or acceleration
